QF.id: Evaluating Fund Performance and Fund Selection_9

question.text: An NPS fund manager can charge a maximum fund management fee of:

explanation.text: The Logic: The workbook's specific NPS Fees and Charges section (page 108) states that pension funds are currently allowed fund management charges in the range of 0.03% to 0.09% p.a. depending on AUM, so the maximum permitted is 0.09% p.a. The Trap: 0.50% and 0.25% are far above the NPS regime; 0.03% is the lower end of the allowed range, not the maximum. Note: Even at the maximum 0.09% p.a., NPS fund management charges remain very low relative to mutual fund expense ratios.
